title: Salesforce Engineer II
description:
**Monotype Global**


Named "One of the Most Innovative Companies in Design" by Fast Company, Monotype brings brands to life through type and technology that consumers engage with every day. The company's rich legacy includes a library that can be traced back hundreds of years, featuring famed typefaces like Helvetica, Futura, Times New Roman and more.


Monotype also provides a first\-of\-its\-kind service that makes fonts more accessible for creative professionals to discover, license, and use in our increasingly digital world. We work with the biggest global brands, and with individual creatives, offering a wide set of solutions that make it easier for them to do what they do best: **design beautiful brand experiences.**

**Monotype Solutions India**


Monotype Solutions India is a strategic center of excellence for Monotype and is a certified Great Place to Work® three years in a row. The focus of this fast\-growing center spans product development, Product Management, Experience Design, User Research, Market Intelligence, Research in areas of Artificial Intelligence and Machine learning, Innovation, Customer Success, Enterprise Business Solutions, and Sales.


Headquartered in the Boston area of the United States and with offices across 4 continents, Monotype is the world’s leading company in fonts. It’s a trusted partner to the world’s top brands and was named “One of the Most Innovative Companies in Design” by Fast Company.


Monotype brings brands to life through the type and technology that consumers engage with every day. The company's rich legacy includes a library that can be traced back hundreds of years, featuring famed typefaces like Helvetica, Futura, Times New Roman, and more. Monotype also provides a first of\-its\-kind service that makes fonts more accessible for creative professionals to discover, license, and use in our increasingly digital world.

**What** **you’ll be doing:**

* Support continuous improvement initiatives — building and configuring flows, triggers, and components — and contribute to outcome delivery alongside project implementation stakeholders.
* Work closely with the development team to write bulk\-safe, governor\-limit\-aware Apex and unit tests, and debug issues to deliver smooth, bug\-free solutions.
* Contribute to the Salesforce COE (Centre of Excellence) and the wider ecosystem by following coding standards and using reusable components and frameworks.
* Learning and adapting to new technologies and capabilities as per the project need.

**What we’re looking for:**

* Familiarity with application Out of Box features and advanced level of automation for ex \- flows, process builders and automations.
* Potential to analyze business requirements with good communication skills.
* Strong hand\-on experience in salesforce lighting experience terminologies and its features.
* Experience managing managed packages.
* Experience in click to configure integrations.
* Hands on knowledge on back\-end \& front\-end coding.
* Expertise in salesforce Sales \& Service cloud offerings.
* Expertise in salesforce lighting experience terminologies and its features.
* Good knowledge on Apex, VF \& LWC framework.
* Hands on knowledge in integrations via click to configure and via custom code.
* Experience with application's best coding practices.
* Ability to manage technical development of projects independently.
* Experience in agile methodologies and framework.
* Familiarity with CI/CD processes and deliveries.
* 2\-5 years of experience in Salesforce as a developer
* Knowledge of Integration frameworks like REST, SOAP, FTP, JSON, etc.
* Should be Platform Developer Certified.
* Should have delivered at least 2 E2E projects.
* Active badge holder in Salesforce Trailhead.
* AI Assisted development using any of the tools like Claude, Cursor or Codex.
* Aware of Vibe\-Coding frameworks and key terms like BMAD, Context and Prompt Engineering.

**Good to Have**

* Docusign – Setup, Integration with Salesforce, CLM.
* SPIFF – Sales Performance Incentive Fund, Salesforce Opportunity Commission setup.
* CPQ – Configuration, customization and Quote to Cash process knowledge.

**What’s in it for you:**

* Hybrid work arrangements and competitive paid time off programs.
* Comprehensive medical insurance coverage to meet all your healthcare needs.
* Competitive compensation with corporate bonus program \& uncapped commission for quota carrying Sales.
* A creative, innovative, and global working environment in the creative and software technology industry.
* Highly engaged Events Committee to keep work enjoyable.
* Reward \& Recognition Programs (including President's Club for all functions).
* Professional onboarding program, including robust targeted training for Sales function.
* Development and advancement opportunities (high internal mobility across organization).
* Retirement planning options to save for your future, and so much more.


Monotype is an Equal Opportunities Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race colour, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status.

title: Software Development Engineer - III (Backend + AI)
description:
**About the Role:**  

As a Software Development Engineer \- III at Innovaccer, you'll be a senior technical leader who stays deep in the code. You'll personally design and build complex, high\-impact parts of our platform — backend services, data pipelines, and the AI/ML\-powered features that increasingly define our products — while setting the technical direction for your team or domain. This is a builder's role first: you'll write production code, own components end to end, and lead by doing, while also shaping architecture and mentoring the engineers around you. You'll work closely with product, clinical, and engineering peers to turn ambitious healthcare goals into robust, scalable software that ships. If you want to operate at Staff scope without stepping away from the keyboard, this role is for you.

**A day in the Life**

* Design, build, and ship complex, critical components of Innovaccer's platform — backend services, APIs, and data pipelines — writing high\-quality production code yourself.
* Build AI/ML\-powered product features end to end: integrating models, designing the systems and data flows around them, and ensuring they perform reliably in production.
* Drive technical design for systems within your team or domain, making hands\-on decisions for scalability, performance, security, and cost, then implementing them.
* Model engineering best practices across the SDLC — code quality, testing, security, observability, and operational excellence — and raise the bar through the code you write and review.
* Build resilient, well\-tested services that integrate cleanly across products and with external healthcare systems.
* Ensure the software you build complies with healthcare and data\-protection requirements, including HIPAA and GDPR, embedding compliance and security into the implementation.
* Debug, profile, and harden production systems, taking ownership of reliability and incident response for the systems you build.
* Provide hands\-on technical mentorship to engineers through design reviews, pairing, and code review.
* Partner with product and clinical stakeholders to turn real\-world needs into well\-scoped, technically sound designs you can deliver.
* Evaluate and recommend technologies, frameworks, and tooling for your team, balancing capability, cost, risk, and time\-to\-value.

**What you Need**

* Bachelor's, Master's, or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5\+ years of software engineering experience with a strong track record of personally building and shipping production systems.
* Deep, current, hands\-on coding expertise in one or more modern languages (e.g., Python, Java, Go, or similar) — this role writes code daily.
* Strong software design skills across distributed systems, backend services, APIs, and data\-intensive architectures.
* Experience building and integrating AI/ML into products — connecting models to real systems, handling data flows, and operationalizing them in production (you don't need to be a research scientist, but you should be comfortable building AI/ML\-powered features).
* Hands\-on experience operating production systems: CI/CD, infrastructure\-as\-code, monitoring, performance tuning, and incident response.
* Familiarity with healthcare data standards (e.g., FHIR, HL7\) and regulatory compliance (HIPAA, GDPR), or the ability to ramp quickly on a regulated domain.
* Strong problem\-solving skills and clear communication, with the ability to align engineers and stakeholders around a technical approach.
* Strong experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and containerization/orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes).

title: Software Development Engineer
description:
Foxit is remaking the way the world interacts with documents through advanced PDF technology and tools. We are a leading global software provider of fast, affordable, and secure PDF solutions that are used by millions of people worldwide. Winner of numerous awards, Foxit has customers in more than 200 countries and global operations. We have a complete product line and an exciting and aggressive development schedule. Our proven PDF technology is disrupting the status quo establishment and has accelerated our company growth. We are proud to list as customers Google, Amazon, and NASDAQ, and with your skills and help, we plan to add many more. Foxit has offices all over the world, including locations in the US, Asia, Europe, and Australia.  

  

For more information, please visit https://www.foxit.com. **Role Summary**
Foxit are looking for a Software Development Engineer with 3–5 years of experience in developing, maintaining, and troubleshooting scalable enterprise applications. The ideal candidate will have strong Java fundamentals and hands\-on experience with both traditional Java web technologies and modern Spring\-based application development. The role involves building robust backend services and RESTful APIs, working with databases and caching technologies, troubleshooting production issues, and collaborating closely with QA, DevOps, Product, and other engineering teams.

**Key Responsibilities:**
* Develop and maintain enterprise applications using Java/J2EE, Spring, Spring Boot, Struts, JSP, and Servlets.
* Design, develop, and maintain RESTful APIs and backend services.
* Work with MySQL, including query optimization and performance tuning.
* Implement and manage caching and session management using Redis/Valkey.
* Deploy, monitor, and troubleshoot applications running on Apache Tomcat. • Debug, investigate, and resolve application and production issues effectively.
* Write and maintain unit tests to ensure application quality and reliabilities
* Participate in code reviews and follow established software development best practices.
* Collaborate with QA, DevOps, Product, and other engineering teams throughout the development lifecycle.
* Contribute to the development and maintenance of scalable, reliable, and high performing enterprise applications.


**Qualifications \& Requirements:**
* 3–5 years of professional experience in Java/J2EE application development.
* Strong knowledge of Core Java, including: Object\-Oriented Programming (OOP), Collections, Multithreading, Java 8\+ concepts
* Hands\-on experience with Spring Framework and Spring Boot.
* Experience with Struts, JSP, Servlets, and Apache Tomcat.
* Strong understanding and practical experience with REST APIs and Microservices.
* Experience with MySQL and SQL, including database performance considerations
* Knowledge of JPA/Hibernate. • Experience with Redis/Valkey for caching and session management.
* Familiarity with Maven/Gradle, Git, and JUnit.
* Strong debugging, analytical, and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to work effectively in a collaborative, cross\-functional engineering environment.
* Experience with AWS.
* Hands\-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes/EKS.
* Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and modern software delivery practices.
* Experience with messaging technologies such as Kafka or RabbitMQ.
* Experience developing or supporting SaaS and/or high\-availability applications.


The role description doesn't fit 100%? But you have the feeling that Foxit could give your career a boost? Let's talk anyway and tell us your story! We are still growing, and some job profiles are not written yet!  

Foxit is a progressive, open\-minded meritocracy. What you’re capable of matters, the rest doesn’t. (We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, or disability status.)

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Backend Developer
description:
**Backend Developer / Data Engineer**

**Location:** Hapur, Uttar Pradesh, India  
**Work Arrangement:** On\-site  
**Contract:** Full\-time

**About GCRS Group**

GCRS Group is a global regulatory consultancy supporting businesses operating across cosmetics, fragrance, personal care, food supplements, medical devices and other regulated consumer products.

Our work spans regulatory compliance, product safety, responsible person services, market access, product stewardship, brand protection and technology\-enabled compliance solutions across international markets including the UK, USA, India, Europe, GCC/UAE and other global markets.

As our technology and digital capabilities continue to grow, we are looking for a **Backend Developer / Data Engineer** to join our India\-based technology team and help develop reliable systems, data infrastructure and backend services that support our internal operations and technology platforms.

**The Role**

You will be responsible for developing, maintaining and improving backend applications, APIs, databases and data pipelines used across GCRS technology platforms and internal systems.

The role combines **backend software development and data engineering**, making it suitable for someone who enjoys building robust systems while also working with structured data, integrations, automation and reporting.

You will work closely with developers, product stakeholders and business teams to understand requirements and translate them into scalable technical solutions.

This is a hands\-on role in a growing environment where you will have the opportunity to contribute to architecture, development standards, automation and the improvement of our overall technology infrastructure.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop and maintain backend applications and services
* Develop secure and reliable APIs and integrations
* Build and maintain databases and data models
* Develop data pipelines for collecting, transforming and processing information
* Integrate internal systems and third\-party services through APIs
* Write clean, maintainable and well\-documented code
* Optimise backend performance, database queries and system reliability
* Develop automated processes for data handling and operational workflows
* Support the development of reporting and analytics infrastructure
* Ensure data accuracy, consistency and integrity
* Identify and resolve backend and data\-related issues
* Conduct testing, debugging and performance improvements
* Work with frontend developers to support application functionality
* Collaborate with AI and technology teams where backend or data infrastructure is required
* Maintain appropriate technical documentation
* Support deployment and ongoing maintenance of applications
* Monitor systems and investigate technical issues
* Follow appropriate security and data\-protection practices
* Contribute to technical architecture and development standards
* Continuously identify opportunities to improve automation and efficiency

**What We Are Looking For**

We are looking for someone who is technically strong, analytical and comfortable working across backend development and data.

You should enjoy solving problems, understanding how systems work and building reliable solutions rather than simply completing individual coding tasks.

You will need to be comfortable working independently while also collaborating closely with other technology and business teams.

**Essential Experience and Skills**

* Experience in backend development, software engineering or data engineering
* Strong knowledge of at least one backend programming language such as Python, Java, Node.js or similar
* Strong understanding of databases and SQL
* Experience developing APIs and system integrations
* Understanding of data structures and data modelling
* Experience working with relational databases
* Understanding of data pipelines and ETL/ELT processes
* Good understanding of software development principles
* Experience with Git and version control
* Strong debugging and problem\-solving skills
* Understanding of application security and data protection
* Ability to understand business requirements and translate them into technical solutions
* Strong attention to detail
* Ability to document technical work clearly
* Ability to work independently and meet deadlines

**Desirable Experience**

* Python\-based data engineering and development of data processing pipelines.
* PostgreSQL, MySQL or similar relational database technologies.
* Cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud.
* Docker for application containerization and deployment.
* Data warehouses, business intelligence systems or analytics platforms.
* Automation and workflow tools used for streamlining data and operational processes.
* AI/ML systems and their integration with data engineering workflows.
* Handling large, complex or high\-volume datasets.
* SaaS, consultancy, technology or professional services environments.

**What Success Will Look Like**

Within your first six months, you will have:

* Developed and maintained reliable backend services
* Improved the performance and stability of existing systems
* Established effective data pipelines and database structures
* Delivered APIs and integrations required by the business
* Improved data quality and accessibility
* Reduced manual data\-processing requirements
* Worked effectively with frontend, AI and business teams
* Contributed to better technical documentation and development standards
* Helped create a stronger and more scalable technology foundation for GCRS

**Why Join Us?**

This is an opportunity to join a growing international business where technology is increasingly important to how we operate and deliver services.

You will have the opportunity to work on meaningful internal and client\-facing technology projects and contribute directly to the development of systems that support an international regulatory business.

**Important:** This is a **fully on\-site role based at the GCRS office in Hapur, Uttar Pradesh**. Candidates must be willing to **work from the Hapur office five days a week**.

Work Location: In person
